native_tools: Pinned Clang 20.1.3, same Microsoft link.exe/lib.exe and other tool hashes across all cells
compiler_cache: not enabled; fresh source, build objects and Cargo home per cell; final LLVM/LLD launcher audit
profiles: Fresh upstream opt-dist training per cell, never imported from another compiler; profile hashes and backend coverage preserved
worker_control: Bootstrap/Cargo/CMake build jobs and inherited process-tree affinity use the selected LP count. Existing upstream training parallelism is unchanged.
topology: Select logical processors 0 through N-1; record physical-core masks and actual affinity. LP is not a physical-core claim.
primary_endpoint: Complete Rust compiler/distribution production wall, including helper preparation, fresh PGO and packaging, excluding extracted tests
secondary_endpoints: Inclusive top-level Rust-PGO, LLVM-PGO, final-distribution and test section wall times
Whole GitHub release job including setup, downloads, uploads and gaps; excluding queue
qualification: Unmodified upstream extracted-distribution tests, exact source prerequisite, complete distribution manifest, active LLVM backend profile counts and native tool/profile-use audits
identity_gate: 8/4-LP cells must match the completed same-run 16-LP source, tool hashes, normalized configuration, hardware and power scheme before production
limits: Single-pass fixed-order observations with newly generated profiles, not a population scaling law, isolated filesystem effect, fixed-profile comparison, or a hosted six-hour feasibility guarantee
not_measured: IronRDP compilation throughput or incremental Rust-ThinLTO benefit
failure_policy: Stop dependent cells on failure; retain partial logs; do not report unfinished production as completed
safety: Shared runner concurrency lock, no competing compiler processes, exact NVMe check, 250 GiB admission guard, no global system-setting changes
